source='''def transform(grid):
    def collapse_adjacent(items):
        result = []
        for item in items:
            if not result or item != result[-1]:
                result.append(item)
        return result

    rows = collapse_adjacent([list(row) for row in grid])
    columns = collapse_adjacent([list(column) for column in zip(*rows)])
    return [list(row) for row in zip(*columns)]
'''
